name: continuation-record-runtime
title: Implement task-bound Continuation Record runtime
description: Add a task-bound, source-digest and CAS-guarded Continuation Record with read-only context projection without taking ownership of formal handoff or OpenViking lifecycle.
creator: penn
notes: First source change is the inherited session-isolation resolver repair: a known current context key without a task pointer must not borrow a foreign sole-session pointer. Preserve only no-identity fallback. This task directly repairs the fork; no separate repair task is created.
